SmartSqlMap.Select: select cast(version_id as text) as version_id, cast(decision_id as text) as decision_id, decision_key, version_number, version_tag, is_published, is_draft, definition_content, checksum, publish_comment, published_by, published_time, created_by, created_time from decision_version where decision_key = #{decisionKey} and version_tag = #{versionTag} order by version_number desc limit 1

select cast(version_id as text) as version_id, cast(decision_id as text) as decision_id, decision_key, version_number, version_tag, is_published, is_draft, definition_content, checksum, publish_comment, published_by, published_time, created_by, created_time from decision_version where decision_key = #{decisionKey} and is_published = true order by coalesce(published_time, created_time) desc, version_number desc limit 1

select cast(version_id as text) as version_id, cast(decision_id as text) as decision_id, decision_key, version_number, version_tag, is_published, is_draft, definition_content, checksum, publish_comment, published_by, published_time, created_by, created_time from decision_version where decision_key = #{decisionKey} and is_draft = true order by created_time desc, version_number desc limit 1

select cast(version_id as text) as version_id, cast(decision_id as text) as decision_id, decision_key, version_number, version_tag, is_published, is_draft, definition_content, checksum, publish_comment, published_by, published_time, created_by, created_time from decision_version where decision_key = #{decisionKey} order by version_number desc, created_time desc

select cast(version_id as text) as version_id, cast(decision_id as text) as decision_id, decision_key, version_number, version_tag, is_published, is_draft, definition_content, checksum, publish_comment, published_by, published_time, created_by, created_time from decision_version where version_id = cast(#{versionId} as uuid) limit 1
SmartSqlMap.Insert: insert into decision_version ( version_id, decision_id, decision_key, version_number, version_tag, is_published, is_draft, definition_content, checksum, publish_comment, published_by, published_time, created_by, created_time ) values ( cast(#{versionId} as uuid), cast(#{decisionId} as uuid), #{decisionKey}, #{versionNumber}, #{versionTag}, #{isPublished}, #{isDraft}, #{definitionContent}, #{checksum}, #{publishComment}, #{publishedBy}, #{publishedTime}, #{createdBy}, #{createdTime} )
SmartSqlMap.Update: update decision_version set is_draft = false where decision_key = #{decisionKey} and version_id <> cast(#{currentVersionId} as uuid) and is_draft = true
update decision_version set is_published = false where decision_key = #{decisionKey} and version_id <> cast(#{currentVersionId} as uuid) and is_published = true
